name: Cat Castle NYC
neighborhoods: Upper Manhattan-based (fosters Manhattan/Bronx); serves all NYC + nearby
notes:
501(c)(3) founded 2018, high-volume foster network (30+ cats at once). SPECIALTY: hard cases others won't take + kittens as young as ONE DAY (neonatal) through seniors (16 yrs). Also HELPS OTHER RESCUERS + public with TNR projects, low-cost spay/neuter, and end-of-life services. Explicit non-discrimination adoption policy. Upper-Manhattan based, serves all NYC. Verified 2026-08-26. Intake: Adoption application on site Intake: contact via site Other channel: foster homes in Manhattan/Bronx
